records.title: Do AI Agents Understand Computer Architecture?
records.reason: 一次要旨: Agents are increasingly asked to design hardware, and increasingly reported to succeed. Such reports establish that a design improved; they cannot establish why. records.title: Closed-World Resolution Against Tool Hallucination in LLM Agents
records.reason: 一次要旨: Tool-augmented large language model (LLM) agents fail in a way no tool-selection or tool-security method addresses: they call tools that do not exist and pass arguments no schema declares.
